title: Training Demo workspace and tooling foundation

target_symbols.reason: Defines reproducible repository commands and root tooling.
Defines isolated API, web, and worker package boundaries.

acceptance: pnpm workspace declares API, web, worker, and shared config packages.
Node and pnpm versions are pinned and package dependencies are locked.
Root commands for lint, typecheck, test, integration test, build, and format checking exist and execute successfully for the empty foundation.
Package boundaries are documented and checked without creating business features.
No secrets, customer data, production configuration, Git push, deployment, or business UI are introduced.
